notes.images: SVG uses WinUI secure static rendering. Other baseline images use Windows bitmap codecs. GIF animation is preserved on the BitmapImage path.
notes.platformImages: Recognized extensions, not a promise of decoding: WebP, HEIF/AVIF, DDS variants and camera RAW require compatible installed Windows imaging codecs; RAW support varies by camera model.
notes.videos: Recognized containers; playback depends on the installed Media Foundation demuxers, audio/video codecs and OS edition. No bundled FFmpeg or codec installation.
